spans.s:
Saumāpa ‘descendant of Somāpa,’ is the patronymic of the two Mānutantavyas, teachers in the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa.
Foot notes xiii. 5, 3, 2, where Eggeling, Sacred Books of the East, 44, 392, has Saumapa.
Saumāpi, ‘descendant of Somāpa,’ is the patronymic of a teacher called Priyavrata in the śāṅkhāyana Āraṇyaka (xv. 1).
Saumāyana, ‘descendant of soma,’ is the patronymic of Budha in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa (xxiv. 18, 6).

Saumya is a term of affectionate address (‘my dear’) in the Upaniṣads.
Foot notes Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad, iii. 1, 3; 2, 13 (varia lectia, somya); Chāndogya upaniṣad, iv. 4, 4 et seq.
